_source: Extracted verbatim from pipeline_Q3_BioBERT_5ejes_CORREGIDO.ipynb (Fase 5.5, 'Normalizacion DEFINITIVA', based on a full manual audit of spelling-variant frequencies). Applied in list order to each fragment's text before entity extraction.

patterns.note: hydroxyapatite: 665 real mentions across 13 spelling variants
HAp alone, 232 occurrences, the most frequent variant
chitosan: 'chitosan' dominates; 'cts' is a real variant; 'chitin' is deliberately NOT merged (a different substance)
PCL concentration variants (pcl25, pcl50, pcl35, pcl1, pcl2, pcl3) collapsed to the base material

known_open_limitation: The same word-boundary normalization that collapses hydroxyapatite's spelling variants also maps the standalone abbreviation 'HA' to hydroxyapatite; Supplementary Table S1 documents at least two studies using hyaluronic acid (also commonly abbreviated 'HA') in the same corpus, so a small number of hyaluronic-acid mentions may have been merged into the hydroxyapatite node. Disclosed in the manuscript (Section 4, Q3 discussion) as an unverified, not-fully-ruled-out limitation.
